name: Timi wellhead platform
description: SK318 PSC, sweet gas field discovered 2018; Sarawak Shell operator 75%, PETRONAS Carigali 15%, Brunei Energy Exploration 10%; unmanned WHP tied back to an existing Shell-operated hub via an 80-km pipeline; about 60% lighter than a conventional tender-assisted drilling WHP; up to 50,000 BOEPD at peak (Ocean News, 2023).
